bullets.title: MRVL up 90%+ on NVDA partnership, Google chip design win
bullets.body: Multiple fintwit accounts flagged Marvell's ~91-92% run since being identified as an NVDA investment partner. New signal: Funda AI reports Marvell will design a Google networking chip on Intel's 18A/18AP process, with mass production by end-2027, to be paired with MediaTek's Humufish design.

bullets.title: Wedbush assigns 80%+ probability to Tesla-SpaceX merger by 2027
bullets.body: Wedbush maintains its view that a Tesla-SpaceX merger is most likely post-SpaceX IPO, assigning 80%+ probability with a 2027 timeline. The thesis rests on Tesla's existing SpaceX stake, growing operational ties, and the joint Terafab initiative.

bullets.title: SpaceX IPO targets $1.75T valuation at $135/share; roadshow Thursday
bullets.body: SpaceX plans to sell 555.6 million shares at $135 each, targeting a $75B raise and $1.75T valuation. The roadshow reportedly begins Thursday, making this a key near-term catalyst for TSLA given its SpaceX stake.

bullets.title: NBIS tripled from $84 to $260; ranked #1 Neocloud pick over CRWV and IREN
bullets.body: One fintwit account flagged NBIS as their highest-conviction Neocloud pick, with the stock moving from $84 to $260, validating the thesis. CRWV flagged as burdened by debt interest and IREN criticized for excessive ATM dilution; NBIS cited for SOTP value from Avride and Clickhouse subsidiaries.

bullets.title: AVGO +3%, MRVL +13% pre-market; AI semis rallying despite geopolitical backdrop
bullets.body: Pre-market commentary noted AVGO up 3% and MRVL up 13% as AI semiconductor names led the tape even as US-Iran tensions pushed oil to ~$98/bbl and 10-year yields rose. AI equity raises of ~$300B highlighted as demand backdrop.

bullets.title: COHR hits all-time high above $450
bullets.body: Coherent broke to new all-time highs above $450, with one fintwit account citing strong H2 conviction heading into the move.

bullets.title: Micron at new all-time high pre-market
bullets.body: Micron was flagged trading at a new all-time high in pre-market session, consistent with the broader AI memory demand narrative reinforced by SK Hynix's HBM4E preview (48GB, 4TB/s) at Computex.

bullets.title: Tech sector P/E expanded 50% from March lows to 48x—valuation compression risk flagged
bullets.body: The S&P Tech sector's trailing 12-month P/E jumped from ~32 to 48 since the March 30 low, a 50% multiple expansion. One account noted 'Tech up, everything else down' in relative strength charts and warned this divergence won't last.

bullets.title: JPMorgan raises ASML target to $2,200 from $1,813
bullets.body: JPMorgan raised its ASML price target to $2,200, up from $1,813, though ASML is not a JAT universe ticker. Relevant as a directional read on semiconductor equipment sentiment.

bullets.title: NVDA: Vera CPU and Agent Toolkit headline Computex agentic AI push; buyback debate
bullets.body: At Computex, NVIDIA's Vera CPU and Agent Toolkit positioned the company as the agentic AI era platform, with Oracle cited as backing orders. Separately, one account argued NVDA will need continuous buybacks to move the share price given massive capex cycle concerns.

bullets.title: JPMorgan: AI investment to exceed global military spending by 2027; AI debt now 15% of corporate bond universe
bullets.body: JPMorgan forecasts AI investment surpassing global military spending by 2027. Separately, AI-related corporate debt already represents ~15% of the entire corporate bond universe, highlighting the scale of financial commitment to the theme.

bullets.title: Visa, Mastercard, Stripe backing new stablecoin platform; Coinbase mulling participation
bullets.body: Payment giants Stripe, Visa, and Mastercard are reportedly among backers of a soon-to-debut stablecoin platform, with Coinbase also considering participation. Relevant for fintech and payments sector sentiment.

bullets.title: IREN announces 800MW data center campus in Australia—first local project
bullets.body: IREN announced plans to build an 800MW data center campus in Bundey, Australia, marking the company's first Australian data center project. No financial details disclosed.

bullets.title: Lumentum flagged with high conviction by PhotonCap
bullets.body: PhotonCap posted a 'Die Hard / Do Not Doubt' conviction message on Lumentum ($LITE), with no specific price target or catalyst cited beyond the bull thesis.

bullets.title: BOJ hawkish signals: Ueda warns upside inflation risks likely to materialize soon
bullets.body: BOJ Governor Ueda delivered a series of hawkish statements: upside inflation risks are 'greater overall and likely to emerge sooner rather than later'; delaying policy response could force sharp rate hikes; the deflationary mindset has been 'dispelled' with ~5% Rengo wage growth across firm sizes. One macro account interpreted this as a one-off rather than a sustained tightening cycle.

bullets.title: Tesla UK May sales +18% YoY to 2,812 units
bullets.body: Tesla UK new car registrations rose 18.05% year-over-year in May to 2,812 units, per New Automotive data.

bullets.title: Labor market: job openings per unemployed worker rises to 1.03; professional services at 3-year highs
bullets.body: April JOLTS showed job openings jumping with the openings-per-unemployed ratio rising to 1.03, last above 1:1 in June 2025. Professional and business services vacancies surged to a three-year high. Key data watch: ADP, ISM Services, and Factory Orders also due today.

bullets.title: Auto sales: Ward's May vehicle sales 16.08M; new car MSRP still 29% above pre-pandemic
bullets.body: Ward's total vehicle sales rose to 16.08M in May from 15.92M prior. Average new car MSRP eased to $51,469 in April from a recent peak of $52,217 but remains 29% above the May 2019 level of $39,711.

bullets.title: Bitcoin diverging sharply from Nasdaq; QQQ up 41.5%, BTC down 37% YoY
bullets.body: Nasdaq 100 hit fresh record highs driven by AI-themed inflows (up 41.5% over 12 months) while Bitcoin fell 37% YoY and sits 48% below its prior year peak. One account flagged BTC's break from tech 'getting harder to ignore' as the correlation breaks down.

bullets.title: Trump tariff proposal targets 60 countries over forced labor; new round signals policy escalation
bullets.body: The Trump administration is proposing a new tariff round targeting 60 countries citing forced labor practices. The proposal comes alongside existing Middle East tensions and could add further supply chain disruption risk.
